name: VSee Clinic
one_liner: Customizable telehealth platform trusted by NASA with low-bandwidth video optimization, virtual waiting rooms, and complete practice management features.
best_for: Solo and small practices seeking an affordable all-in-one solution
Providers with patients in areas with limited internet connectivity
Practices needing integrated scheduling, payments, and video
Mental health clinicians wanting customizable patient intake forms
Providers seeking a free starter option to test telehealth
not_for: Large health systems requiring enterprise EHR integration
Practices heavily invested in another PM system (some redundancy)

short_description: HIPAA-compliant telehealth platform with low-bandwidth video, virtual waiting rooms, scheduling, and payment processing built for healthcare practices.
long_description: VSee Clinic is a comprehensive telehealth platform that combines HD video conferencing with practice management features including online scheduling, custom intake forms, and payment processing. Originally developed for NASA to enable telemedicine on the International Space Station, VSee is known for its low-bandwidth optimization that maintains video quality even on slow internet connections, making it ideal for serving patients in rural or underserved areas. The platform offers a free tier for solo practitioners with limited features, making it accessible for those starting with telehealth. VSee Clinic includes virtual waiting rooms, screen sharing, and customizable patient experiences with your practice branding. Mental health providers appreciate the built-in secure messaging, appointment reminders, and custom intake forms that can be completed before sessions. The platform supports multiple providers, making it suitable for group practices, and offers API access for custom integrations.
patient_summary: HIPAA-compliant telehealth platform with low-bandwidth video, virtual waiting rooms, scheduling, and payment processing built for healthcare practices.

pricing.notes: Free tier available for solo providers. Per-provider pricing for group practices. Annual billing discounts available.

privacy.notes: BAA provided even on free tier. End-to-end encryption for all video sessions.

faqs.q: Does VSee work with slow internet connections?
faqs.a: Yes, VSee was originally developed for NASA and is specifically optimized for low-bandwidth environments. The video maintains quality even on 3G cellular connections or slow rural internet. This makes it ideal for serving patients in areas with limited connectivity.

faqs.q: Is the free VSee Clinic plan really HIPAA compliant?
faqs.a: Yes, even the free tier of VSee Clinic is fully HIPAA compliant with a signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA) included. All video sessions use end-to-end encryption regardless of plan level.

faqs.q: Can patients book appointments online with VSee?
faqs.a: Yes, VSee Clinic includes online scheduling where patients can view your availability and book appointments directly. Paid plans include SMS and email reminders, intake forms, and payment collection at booking.

faqs.q: Does VSee support group therapy sessions?
faqs.a: Yes, VSee Plus and Pro plans support group video sessions with up to 4 participants, suitable for couples therapy, family sessions, and small group therapy. Larger group sessions would require a different platform.
